About us

Negin Nakhl Ebnous is an Iranian date company based in Jiroft, Kerman. We supply, pack and export dates for wholesale buyers, with a simple aim: a clear, reliable way to work together, from first inquiry to shipment.

  • Premium Iranian dates
  • Professional packaging
  • Quality control
  • International export

Our process

The journey of every order.

  1. Cultivation

    Dates grow and ripen on the palms of southern Iran.

  2. Harvesting

    Harvested when ripe, by variety.

  3. Sorting & quality control

    Dates are sorted and checked before packing.

  4. Packaging

    Packed to suit your market and order size.

  5. International shipping

    Shipping details are coordinated with you.

Export & global markets

We work with wholesale buyers and importers. Every order is arranged directly: variety, quantity, packaging and destination.

Wholesale supply

Bulk quantities of the varieties above, based on availability.

Packaging options

Weight and packaging type chosen to suit your target market.

Shipping coordination

Destination, timing and shipping details arranged together.
